title.zh: Arbitrum 安全委员会冻结与 Binance 漏洞相关的约 3050 万美元资产
title.en: Arbitrum Security Council freezes ~$30.5M tied to Binance exploit

current_state.zh: The Arbitrum Security Council executed transactions to freeze approximately $30.5M associated with the Binance exploit.

updates.title_zh: Arbitrum Security Council Takes Emergency Action to Transfer Binance-Related Sto

updates.what_changed_zh: The Arbitrum Security Council used emergency powers to transfer 74,559,805 ARB and 8,425 ETH tied to the Binance exploit from their original Arbitrum One address into an intermediary frozen wallet controlled by further council or DAO action.
